svg.title: The market releases into an open pier.
svg.text: UNION PIER / URBAN STUDY / REVISION G / 03
The market releases into an open pier.
Site plan / Eighteen landward halls, five harbour cutouts, six open shade pavilions
Large enclosed bazaar buildings sit landward of x=176 m in model
coordinates. The outer pier carries open pavilions and
recreation. Piles are conceptual supports, not engineered member
Two community centres, two hotels, a port pavilion and the
maritime visitor centre use continuous sculpted bodies and
terraced volumes. Residential quarters retain their finer grain.
MODEL COORDINATES / +Y NORTH AS CONFIRMED BY DESIGNER / ACADEMIC PROPOSAL
2 NOV 2026 · Geometry-based study; context uses and legal site boundary are not verified.
